versions.changelog:
- Initial release of PRE Engineering skill to set up a PRE (Plan-Review-Execute) multi-agent collaboration framework in an existing project.
- Guides the user through interactive requirements collection and refinement in two efficient steps, auto-infers details from project files when possible.
- Generates and writes five core files: project goals, collaboration log, and guide documents for Planner, Executor, and Reviewer, with overwrite checks and template support.
- Confirms and records project timezone for consistent log entries.
- Presents clear startup instructions upon completion.
